m6_pin_grant.granted_by: STEWARD-QKc 2026-10-22 decision (b) (KDIE5-TV ctl_r1 grant, re-issued for the nc32 body; owner rule: M6 pin grants allowed when the tile does not grow)
m6_pin_grant.reason: Pin-density grant, NOT growth: the relm frame W / E faces carry 2524 pins each on 172.776 um (14.6 / um on one layer > the 12 b/um/layer limit); M4 + M6 pin-only edge contacts = 7.3 / um / layer.  Outline 1123.176 x 172.776 and the M5 signal / PG cap unchanged; routed DEF / LEF M6 audit required.

purpose: KDIE5-RTL 10-22 (FB): die-bindable native-census kit of the release KV die qkd_kvs_ctl at the relm frame 1123.176 x 172.776: body = rtl/qwen_sys/static_kv_die_20261017/qkd_kvs_ctl_nc32.sv (KV-CTL10 c32 members + DSTG, verbatim c32i body, census PASS max 32 in gate c32k; die knob OT_KV_CTL_NC32=1 with OT_KV_CTL_C32=2).  Pin plan / M6 pin-only grant = ctl_r1 (KDIE5-TV decision b).  6 ctl_sram_1r1w_64x128_p192 in one centre row; pin registers OFF (die charges 0 face edges, as ctl_r1).  Schedule deltas of the body: own leave guard +2, boot setup_ready +2, +1 boot-write edge (DSTG).
